segments.title: Therapy: Guy Redacted Session

segments.title: CryptoZeu$: Pumpkin Carver & Mother Interventions

segments.notes: Munch (as skeleton mayor) leads multi-hour Valheim rebuild: press conference, first citizens (MVT, Exterminator, Stanton), skate park half-pipe, mayor's mansion on stilts, boar pen, green skeleton transformation, resource cheats enabled.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News aired a marathon Friday Newstravaganza anchored by Case Blackwell, featuring a solo news desk covering Alaska election interference, AI food photography failures, and Texas Longhorns' Bevo Labs analytics. The Munch & Crum debate desk returned with Munch appearing as an immortal green skeleton; he won an ice cream vs. frozen yogurt debate after Kendelle's walk-through vote. Hype Train derailed into a reptilian gorilla conspiracy freestyle, then received a chaotic therapy session from Guy Redacted. DJ C4 produced a chat-written Ska theme for Rennerton with Munch on vocals. Brandon (CryptoZeu$) played Pumpkin Carver amid mother interventions. The broadcast concluded with a 2.5-hour Valheim reconstruction stream where Munch, as skeleton mayor, built a press corps, mayor's mansion, skate park, and boar pen while welcoming the first three citizen-players to the reborn Rennerton.
